author: Ryan Shirley
description:
Alaska is one of the most beautiful and wild places on Earth. I recently returned from traveling across Alaska and want to share with you my favorite places in this travel guide. From watching bears fish for salmon at Brooks Falls, to taking a scenic cruise through the Kenai Fjords, Alaska is waiting to be experienced. Where is your favorite place in Alaska?

Special thanks to Brown Bear Bay for guiding & accommodating us for several days as we filmed bears fishing for salmon. Here's there contact if you want to visit: https://www.northwildtravel.com/brownbearbay

Also special thanks to @ViktorPosnov for helping with his Aleutian Islands footage. He made incredible films there - https://youtu.be/uF3Ofr_rj28
